2Sign into CBS normally if needed, then open the fantasy-football league you want to connect.
3Click your Inner Sanctum CBS bookmark on the CBS league page. The sanitized read-only capture returns directly to this Inner Sanctum tab.
Read only. Inner Sanctum does not submit lineups, add/drop players, place waiver claims, make trades, or otherwise modify your CBS league.
CBS Connect is in beta while we expand testing across additional CBS league configurations. No CBS password or browser cookie is stored by The Inner Sanctum.

⚠️ These values can provide access to your ESPN account session. They are sent only to the ESPN connection function for the current request and are not intentionally saved in Inner Sanctum league connection state.
Public leagues need only a League ID. Private leagues require ESPN session values for the connection request. ESPN does not provide a supported public fantasy API, so this integration remains beta.
